from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyMonetaryFunds(BaseModel):
    """Monetary funds reported in one company's financial report for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as it appears in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code if available")
    monetary_funds_amount: float | None = Field(description="The monetary funds balance reported in the document")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'CNY', '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of balance, e.g. '期末余额', '报告期末余额'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_monetary_funds: list[CompanyMonetaryFunds]
